subject: reasoning
question: Arman starts from point A and drives 32 km towards the south. He then takes a left turn, drives 37 km, turns left and drives 35 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 38 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Arman starts from point A and drives 32 km towards the south.

He then takes a left turn and drives 37 km.

Again, he takes a left turn and drives 35 km.

He then takes another left turn and drives 38 km.

Finally, he takes a left turn and drives 3 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e6944c38599acc21ed8cbfa4ace8adb45aaea2ce1cd6ac9a8058278fe3211c5.png] 

Facing west, left turn means south.

Moves 3 km south.

Final Position P = 1 km West of point A

To reach point A again, Arman must move **1 km towards the east**.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".**
